correctness.rationale: The Harris--Tu/Friedland--Krattenthaler product is algebraically cancelled to an adjacent-rank ratio and then to the exact curvature quotient. The log-concave/log-convex criterion is equivalent to a single quadratic inequality in n-r, and the equality condition is exactly the displayed negative Pell equation. The standalone exact checker reproduces these identities from the product formula in a broad finite range.

value.rationale: The theorem gives the complete second-order behavior of a fundamental enumerative invariant along the rank stratification of square determinantal varieties: one sharp curvature switch, an explicit universal asymptotic threshold, and a Diophantine equality locus. It is structural rather than a finite table, isolated computation, or arbitrary parameter slice.
